# volcano_project_auth_theme (Resource)

The visual theme for a project's hosted auth pages. Singleton - read back via the appearance endpoint since theme has no GET of its own.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "volcano_project_auth_theme" "example" {
  project_id = volcano_project.example.id

  colors = {
    background  = "#ffffff"
    surface     = "#f5f5f5"
    text        = "#111111"
    accent      = "#5b21b6"
    accent_text = "#ffffff"
  }

  font    = "system"
  scale   = "default"
  density = "comfortable"
  radius  = "medium"
}
```

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import volcano_project_auth_theme.example <project-id>
```
